borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Retrospective application for change of use of the dwelling (Use Class C3) to a HMO (Use Class C4) with proposed associated electric vehicle charging point, car parking and refuse and cycle storage
decision_conditions: The proposed development would result in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. While it would provide a dwelling in the form of an HMO, it fails to demonstrate that there is an identified need, would cause a loss of local amenity including to neighbouring occupiers, and would not be located in an area with a high level of access to public transport. As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies: - National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)- Policies D6, D14 and T4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies SP3, SP8, DMD1, DMT1, DMH5 and DMSI3 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037

The proposed HMO has the potential to increase activity level and coming and goings to and from the site leading to additional levels of noise and disturbance at the property. The proposal is therefore likely to have a negative impact on neighbouring amenity in this street of family housing and in turn the health and wellbeing of neighbouring residents. As such the proposal is contrary to the following:- Policies DMD 1, SP 7 and DMSI 3 of the Local Plan (September 2024)

The proposed development fails to demonstrate that additional demand for parking from the development could be adequately accommodated in the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore likely to add unacceptably to parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site.  As such, it fails to comply with the following policies which seek to ensure proposals show how car parking will be designed and managed and to take into consideration on-street parking availability and existing and planned public transport provision:- National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)- Policies T1, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)

The proposal fails to provide sufficient information regarding the location of bin storage and waste management. The proposal lacks clarity and is therefore is unacceptable and contrary to the following:- Part 3 in policy DMSI 8 of the Local Plan (September 2024)- The Council's Planning Advice Note on Waste and Recycling Provisions in New and Refurbished Residential Developments (dated 20/05/2021).
